mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the reflex connections was most worthwhile because the result connected the inner-ear structures to steady vision and posture in an everyday situation.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the nerve pathways and then attaching the organs to the body felt repetitive: both results mainly showed nerves reaching toward the brainstem.

surprise.text: The weighted sensors respond both to gravity and to changes in straight-line motion; the described comparison helped distinguish those situations.

arbitrary.text: No combination felt purposeless, though after the first choice each decision had only one available combination, so the sequence offered little room for meaningful choice.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it connected body structures to an everyday experience as clearly as the final reflex did, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
